## Checklist

- [ ] `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...` and `golangci-lint run` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has tests (table-driven; TUIs driven by key presses)
- [ ] Results on stdout, status on stderr, and a `--json` form for anything a script needs
- [ ] README and `--help` updated if a command or flag changed
